content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Homebuilder selling single-family and attached homes to individual buyers, with in-house mortgage financing, matching KB Home's model."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers with mortgage and title services, same as KB Home."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Develops and sells finished lots to homebuilders on a B2B basis; it does not build and sell homes to consumers."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with in-house mortgage financing, like KB Home."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and townhomes directly to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells detached homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with mortgage and title services supporting sales."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title and property insurance and sells policies to lenders and businesses; it does not build homes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Sells life insurance and runs cemeteries and mortuaries; homebuilding and home sales are not part of its business."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells detached and attached homes, including active adult homes, to individual buyers with affiliated mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Diversified Florida company running hotels, clubs, timber and commercial leasing; homebuilding is only a minor part of its business."}]}
